answer: Audits are recorded in oasis, queued in velvet, and kernel publishes the wait time. A farm of 183 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 60 identities per epoch. A farm of 4945 identities would post 5000 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
